fee_notes: Single unit fee $19,950; non-refundable. VetFran discount of $2,500 available. Area development additional license: $15,000 for 1 additional studio, $10,000 each for 2+ additional studios. Existing franchisees have been offered discounted fee of $14,950 at convention on rare occasions.
raw_excerpt: You will pay an initial lump sum franchise fee of $19,950 for a single unit license. This fee is deemed fully earned and non-refundable at the time the Franchise Agreement is executed.
